BiblicalUsage: Tebaliah was the third son of Hosah the porter, a gatekeeper of the house of the Lord. He is named among the sons of Hosah in the courses of the porters, and his father's house kept the gates.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the porter's sons matter as much as the priests, and Tebaliah's name is kept among the gatekeepers.
